title: Driveways
shortDescription: Smart driveway surfaces with reliable drainage, neat edging and a strong arrival experience.
overview: We build driveways that are practical for daily vehicle use while improving the look and value of the front of the property.
benefits: Block paving, gravel, sett and hybrid finishes
process: Install finish, edges and final compaction

faq.question: Do driveways need permeable drainage?
faq.answer: Many front driveway projects need to manage surface water responsibly. We advise on permeable systems, channels and soakaway routes during planning.

faq.question: Can you widen an existing drive?
faq.answer: Yes. We can extend, re-edge or replace existing driveway areas depending on levels, boundaries and drainage.

title: Patios
shortDescription: Porcelain, natural stone and clay patio spaces laid with crisp detailing and dependable drainage.
overview: Eltoromia creates patios that feel like an extension of the home, with careful setting out, resilient sub-bases, clean falls and material choices that suit the property.
benefits: Porcelain, sandstone, limestone and clay options
Drainage and levels planned before installation
process: Lay, joint, clean and hand over

faq.question: Is porcelain paving slippery?
faq.answer: Outdoor-rated porcelain has textured finishes designed for exterior use. We recommend suitable slip ratings and explain cleaning requirements before installation.

faq.question: How long does a patio take?
faq.answer: A typical domestic patio may take one to three weeks depending on excavation, access, steps, drainage and weather.

title: Paving
shortDescription: Detailed paving for pathways, courtyards, terraces and utility spaces with durable foundations.
overview: Our paving work brings order and rhythm to gardens, joining entrances, seating areas and utility spaces with surfaces that drain correctly and look settled.
benefits: Tidy transitions between lawn, gravel and planting

faq.question: Can paving be matched to existing stone?
faq.answer: Often, yes. We can source complementary materials or create a deliberate contrast when an exact match is not available.

faq.question: Do paths need a sub-base?
faq.answer: Yes. Even light-use paths need proper preparation to avoid movement, dips and poor drainage.

title: Artificial Grass & Turf
shortDescription: Artificial turf and real turf laid on a permeable base, with proper edge restraint so it stays flat.
overview: Artificial grass is one of the jobs we are asked for most, usually where a lawn has thinned out under trees or turned to mud over winter. The turf itself is the easy part. What makes it last is the base underneath and the edge holding it down.
benefits: Usable all year, including through a wet winter
Works where grass has failed under mature trees
Permeable base so water drains rather than sits
Real turf supplied and laid where you would rather have grass
features: Timber, sleeper or block edge restraint
process: Strip out the old lawn and excavate
Lay and compact a permeable base
Lay, join, weight and brush the turf

faq.question: Will artificial grass drain properly?
faq.answer: It does when the base is built for it. We excavate, lay a permeable sub-base and blind it before the turf goes down, so surface water drains through rather than sitting on top.

faq.question: Can you lay real turf instead?
faq.answer: Yes. We prepare, level and turf lawns as well, and will say honestly which one suits your garden, the light it gets and how you want to use it.

title: Fencing
shortDescription: Contemporary boundary, privacy and decorative fencing installed with clean lines and robust posts.
overview: Eltoromia installs fencing that improves privacy, frames planting and strengthens the look of the garden without making the space feel boxed in.
benefits: Concrete, timber or steel post systems
process: Install posts, panels and finishing trims

faq.question: Can you replace one damaged section?
faq.answer: Yes. We handle targeted repairs as well as full boundary upgrades.

faq.question: What fence height is allowed?
faq.answer: Rules vary by location and boundary position. We can flag common height considerations, but homeowners should verify specific restrictions with the local authority.

title: Brickwork
shortDescription: Garden walls, planters, steps and retaining details built to complement the house and landscape.
overview: Our brickwork adds permanence and structure to outdoor spaces, from raised beds and steps to low retaining walls and boundary features.

faq.question: Can you match my house brick?
faq.answer: We can source close matches or recommend a complementary brick where a perfect match is not available.

faq.question: Do garden walls need footings?
faq.answer: Yes. Proper footings are essential for stability, especially for retaining walls or walls exposed to movement and frost.

title: Decking
shortDescription: Timber and composite decking for raised seating areas, garden studios and outdoor living zones.
overview: We design and install decking with strong subframes, practical access, discreet fixings and material choices that suit the maintenance level you want.
process: Fit boards, trims and safety details

faq.question: Is composite decking worth it?
faq.answer: Composite decking costs more upfront but offers low maintenance and consistent colour. Timber can be warmer and more natural but needs more care.

faq.question: Can decking work on sloped gardens?
faq.answer: Yes. Decking can be a strong option for level seating on awkward gradients when the structure is designed correctly.

title: Garden Landscaping
shortDescription: Complete soft and hard landscaping that turns unused gardens into layered, practical outdoor rooms.
overview: Eltoromia combines construction, planting, lawn preparation, paths, lighting zones and finishing details into gardens that feel coherent and easy to live with.
benefits: Practical spaces for dining, play and relaxing
process: Discover how the garden should feel

faq.question: Do you supply plants?
faq.answer: Yes. We can source trees, shrubs, perennials and hedging suited to the site and maintenance preference.

faq.question: Can you keep existing mature plants?
faq.answer: Where practical, yes. We survey what is worth retaining and protect key plants during construction.

title: Garden Transformations
shortDescription: Full outdoor redesign and build projects for gardens that need a complete rethink.
overview: Garden transformations bring together layout, hard landscaping, planting, privacy, levels and lighting infrastructure into a cohesive outdoor living space.
benefits: Single coordinated plan and build team
A finish designed to mature beautifully

faq.question: How long does a transformation take?
faq.answer: Most complete garden transformations run from four to ten weeks on site once design and materials are confirmed.

faq.question: Can you include lighting and irrigation?
faq.answer: Yes. We can install ducting and coordinate specialist electrical or irrigation elements as part of the wider project.

title: Garden Maintenance
shortDescription: Regular cutting, edging, hedge work and seasonal tidying to keep a finished garden looking finished.
overview: We maintain gardens we have built and gardens we have not. Regular visits keep lawns, edges, hedges and borders under control so the garden does not slide back into a clearance job.
benefits: Regular visits on a schedule that suits the garden
Lawns cut, striped and edged back to the borders
Hedges, shrubs and borders kept in shape
Terraces and paths blown down and left clear
features: Seasonal tidy-ups and green waste removal
process: Walk the garden and agree the visit scope
Set a frequency that matches the season
Cut, edge, trim and weed on each visit
Clear down and take the green waste away

faq.question: Do you take on one-off tidies?
faq.answer: Yes. Plenty of our maintenance work starts as a single big tidy, and some of it stays as a one-off.

faq.question: Do you take the green waste away?
faq.answer: Yes, cuttings and garden waste go with us at the end of the visit unless you would rather keep them for composting.

title: Garden Clearance
shortDescription: Overgrown gardens, old paving, rubble and failed structures cleared out and taken away.
overview: Some gardens have to be emptied before anything can be designed. We clear overgrowth, break out old paving and concrete, strip rotten decking and fencing and take the waste away, leaving ground you can actually build on.
benefits: Fully overgrown plots taken back to bare ground
Old paving, concrete and rubble broken out and removed
Rotten decking, sheds and fencing stripped
Machine access used where the site allows it
process: Assess access and what has to come out
Break out and load old hard surfaces
Remove the waste and leave the ground level

faq.question: How overgrown is too overgrown?
faq.answer: We have cleared gardens that had not been touched in years and were solid brambles. If you can no longer walk into it, it is the right job for us.

faq.question: Can clearance lead straight into a build?
faq.answer: Usually yes, and it is more efficient that way. We can clear, then carry on into paving, fencing or turfing without a second mobilisation.

title: Outdoor Renovations
shortDescription: Targeted upgrades for tired patios, broken boundaries, poor access and underused garden zones.
overview: Not every garden needs a blank-sheet redesign. We renovate problem areas with a practical scope that improves daily use and refreshes the finish.
benefits: Ideal before selling or seasonal entertaining

faq.question: Can you renovate in phases?
faq.answer: Yes. We can plan works so each phase improves the garden without causing avoidable rework later.

faq.question: Do you repair unsafe steps?
faq.answer: Yes. We can rebuild or replace steps, landings and transitions where levels or materials have become unsafe.
